en.p: Let $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{Q}$ be the two distinct points where the graph of the function

meets the $x$-axis, and for a constant $k\ (k>4)$, let $\mathrm{R}$ be the point where the line $x=k$ meets the $x$-axis. Let $A$ be the area of the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$ and segment $\mathrm{PQ}$, and let $B$ be the area of the region enclosed by the curve $y=f(x)$, the line $x=k$, and segment $\mathrm{QR}$. When $A=2B$, what is the value of $k$? (The $x$-coordinate of point $\mathrm{P}$ is negative.) [4 points]
